compiled_state.title: [merge-to-main-pr.sh]: --resume after out-of-band (FP-recovery web-UI) PR1 merge creates a redundant new staged ref + PR1 instead of advancing to PR2
compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
### 1. Technical Environment
* **code_version:** 07ec8b6ed4 (post-588e go-live; 3ebb durable-resume on main)

### 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior (observed driving the ef39 promotion)

#### Expected Behavior
When PR1 (worktree -> staged) is merged OUT-OF-BAND via the FP-recovery path (a human bypass-actor merges it in the GitHub web UI), `merge-to-main.sh --resume` should detect the merged PR1 (level-triggered from GitHub PR state, per 3ebb DD2 durable-resume) and ADVANCE to PR2 (staged -> main) against the staged ref PR1 actually merged into. This is the documented FP-recovery->PR2 "G-C seam" (830c runbook note).

#### Actual Behavior
After PR1 #704 (worktree-ef39-selfheal -> staged-4a21aca54b3c-1780860607) was merged via the web UI, `merge-to-main.sh --resume` did NOT recognize the merge. It created a BRAND-NEW staged ref (staged-2d18a30a9e9d-1780862126) and a redundant PR1 #706 (which then FP-failed review-sub-pr again), instead of creating PR2 from staged-4a21aca54b3c-1780860607. Net effect: an extra/orphaned staged ref + duplicate PR1, and the promotion cannot complete via --resume. A related spurious PR (#705) was minted from a sibling branch in the same family (a merge-to-main invocation creating a redundant staged PR1).

NOT covered by ef39 (diverged/spent source-branch self-heal) nor 3274 (_restage_execute hardening) — this is a distinct resume/state-reconstruction gap: durable-resume (3ebb DD2) reconstructs state but does not map an out-of-band web-UI PR1 merge into "advance to PR2 from the merged staged ref."

#### Fix direction (for /dso:fix-bug)
On --resume, detect a MERGED PR1 for the source branch (gh pr list --head <branch> --state merged, fail-closed on indeterminate) and resolve the staged ref it merged into; if found, advance to PR2 against THAT staged ref rather than minting a new staged ref + PR1. Guard against creating a second staged ref when a recently-merged PR1 + its staged ref already exist.

### 6. Logs
Closed redundant #706 + spurious #705. staged-4a21aca54b3c-1780860607 holds the merged ef39 content (incl. a web-UI merge commit 04b5e8ddf8).
